description_en: Queries the running logs of an ETL task
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-etl-job-logs --dts-job-id vd0000000002ls --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeEtlJobLogs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ETL task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html operation to query the task ID
parameters.help_zh: ETL任务ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html接口查询任务ID
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the DTS instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh: DTS实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html接口查询阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

DynamicCode.description_en: The dynamic error code associated with this request
DynamicCode.description_zh: 与本次请求相关的动态错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en: The dynamic error message associated with this request
DynamicMessage.description_zh: 与本次请求相关的动态错误信息
DynamicMessage.example: present environment is not support,so skip.

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned when the specified ETL task ID is invalid and the corresponding task cannot be found
ErrCode.description_zh: 传入的ETL任务ID错误，找不到对应的任务

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the specified ETL task ID is invalid and the corresponding task cannot be found. The task may have been deleted
ErrMessage.description_zh: 传入的ETL任务ID错误，找不到对应的任务（任务可能已删除）
ErrMessage.example: The specified dts job id %s is not exists.

EtlRunningLogs.description_en: The array of ETL task running log objects
EtlRunningLogs.description_zh: 返回ETL任务运行日志对象数组

items.description_en: The array of ETL task running log objects
items.description_zh: 返回ETL任务运行日志对象数组

Content.description_en: The description of the ETL task running status

ContentKey.description_en: The status, which indicates the name of the module that generated the log, such as the transformation module of the ETL task
ContentKey.description_zh: 状态，即产生日志的模块名，比如ETL任务的转换模块

EtlId.description_en: The ID of the ETL task

LogDatetime.description_en: The timestamp when the log was generated
LogDatetime.description_zh: 记录时间戳（产生日志的时间）

Status.description_en: The log level. Valid values: ERROR, WARN, INFO, and DEBUG

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. A value of false indicates a failure
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功，如果失败则返回false
